signal: Alogent's Unify platform was shortlisted at the Banking Tech Awards USA 2026 and named a finalist in three 2026 PayTech Awards

email.body1:
Jamie, saw Alogent's Unify get shortlisted at the Banking Tech Awards USA and land three PayTech finalist spots this year.

Award momentum usually surfaces more banks and credit unions than the sales team can work before attention fades, and that is where good deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Alogent off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jamie, quick follow-up for Alogent.

Awards drive inbound interest faster than headcount can keep up. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to book to hit the number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Alogent needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jamie, last bit of proof for Alogent.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alogent's reply rate likely compares to other fintech and banking software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jamie, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem. Timing matters most right after award buzz, and I know that window gets busy fast.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a banking sales motion? I will tailor it to Alogent either way.
